sources.title: ruri-v3-310m: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Q: How does this model handle documents longer than 512 tokens? A: Unlike Ruri v1/v2, ruri-v3-310m supports sequences up to 8192 tokens natively, so it can embed full paragraphs or short articles without truncation. The expanded vocabulary (100K tokens vs 32K in v1/v2) also makes input sequences shorter for the same text, improving efficiency.

sources.snippet: Ruri v3 (310M) is Nagoya University's Japanese text embedding model built on the ModernBERT architecture, optimised for semantic similarity and retrieval in Japanese. It is part of the Ruri series, which targets Japanese-specific sentence embedding quality.
